author: HSinghHira
tagline: Live, self-hosted port monitoring and discovery for your homelab.
description:
portracker automatically scans your host and Docker containers to build a live, accurate map of every port in use, so messy spreadsheets and surprise port conflicts stop happening.

**Features**

- Automatic port discovery for both host system ports and Docker
  containers, with clear separation between internal and published
  ports

- Peer-to-peer monitoring — add other portracker instances as
  peers to see every server, container, and VM from one dashboard

- Optional built-in authentication with a first-run setup wizard;
  portracker does not support OIDC or any external identity
  provider yet, only its own username and password login

- Lightweight single-container app with an embedded SQLite
  database — no external database required


**How to use?**
1. Open portracker from the Zima OS dashboard. 2. Since authentication is turned on, complete the setup wizard
   and create your admin username and password.
3. portracker starts scanning right away — no further setup is
   needed to see host and Docker ports.
4. Add other portracker instances as peers from the Settings gear
   icon to monitor multiple machines from one screen.
5. Caching, UDP scanning, and TrueNAS integration can all be
   tweaked later through the container's environment variables.

tips.before_install:
1. Find SESSION_SECRET in the portracker service.
2. Replace it with your own — generate one at
   [randomkeygen.com](https://randomkeygen.com/) — before going
   live.

3. Start the portracker installation.
4. Open portracker from the Zima OS dashboard.
5. You will see a login screen because ENABLE_AUTH is turned
   on.

6. Follow the setup wizard to create your admin username and
   password.

7. If you ever forget your password, look up portracker's
   RECOVERY_MODE setting in its own docs to reset it.
